description: Ministry of Highways - Galle Port Access Road under Section 86 of National Thoroughfares Act, No. 40 of 2008
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves a legal/regulatory matter - an Order issued under Section 86 of the National Thoroughfares Act, No. 40 of 2008. It restricts public access to a specific national highway for regulatory purposes (preventing unauthorized land reclamation and improving road mobility). While it mentions a minister's name, this is in the context of exercising statutory powers rather than a personnel appointment or portfolio assignment. The content focuses on legal authority, regulatory restrictions, and detailed access specifications rather than government structure or personnel changes.
